Institutional Investors Are Selling Marriott International Inc (NASDAQ:MAR)
May 30, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney Sentiment for Marriott International Inc (NASDAQ:MAR)
Marriott International Inc (NASDAQ:MAR) institutional sentiment decreased to 0.71 in Q1 2018 . Its down -0.38, from 1.09 in 2017Q4. The ratio is negative, as 233 funds increased and opened new equity positions, while 327 cut down and sold their holdings in Marriott International Inc. The funds in our partner’s database now have: 216.91 million shares, down from 224.71 million shares in 2017Q4. Also, the number of funds holding Marriott International Inc in their top 10 equity positions decreased from 19 to 18 for a decrease of 1. Sold All: 38 Reduced: 289 Increased: 158 New Position: 75.
Marriott International, Inc. operates, franchises, and licenses hotels and timeshare properties worldwide. The company has market cap of $48.37 billion. The firm operates through three divisions: North American Full-Service, North American Limited-Service, and International. It has a 37.92 P/E ratio. It also operates, markets, and develops residential properties, as well as provides services to home/condominium owner associations.
The stock increased 1.75% or $2.35 during the last trading session, reaching $136.9. About 500,740 shares traded. Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAR) has risen 29.51% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.94% the S&P500.
Analysts await Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAR) to report earnings on August, 6. They expect $1.36 earnings per share, up 20.35 % or $0.23 from last year’s $1.13 per share. MAR’s profit will be $480.56M for 25.17 P/E if the $1.36 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.34 actual earnings per share reported by Marriott International, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 1.49 % EPS growth.
